VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"` where `h` comes from the `site_settings` value for `embeddable_hosts` (split by newlines). If any stored host line contains an apostrophe (or other SQL-significant characters), the SQL becomes invalid and the migration can fail; it also bypasses proper escaping/quoting.
